title: Eternal Enchantments
description: RPG-inspired enchants brought into the game
body:
# Description RPG-inspired enchantments for player progression, fully server-friendly. The host spawns a unique villager selling special tomes, giving them control over how players access these enchantments. # Items
**Mystic Tome** ![mystic_tome](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ddf2ce34a7bc765e0f3dcc4d3b070720113a0c74.png) Give a random enchantment based on tier. **Weight:** **Common** - 10 **Uncommon** - 5 **Rare** - 3 **Legendary** - 1 **Curse** - 1
# Mod Compatibility Eternal Enchantments fully supports [Enchantment Descriptions](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-descriptions), [Idwtialsimmoedm](https://modrinth.com/mod/idwtialsimmoedm), and [Enchantment Insights](https://modrinth.com/mod/enchantment-insights) allowing players to view a short summary of each enchantment’s effects. # Resourcepack If using the datapack, be sure to install the [resourcepack](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/eternal-resourcepack) # Information [[Click Here]](https://eternalstudios.net/Enchantments/Enchantment+List) to see the enchantment list
Commands | Admin | | | ---------------- | ------------------------------ | | **Action** | **Command** | | Give Mystic Tome | function eternal:admin/give/mystic_tome | | Summon Trader | function eternal:admin/summon/trader | | Uninstall | function eternal:admin/uninstall |
